description:
The models available for future-climate morphing: `models` are global CMIP6 models (NASA NEX-GDDP, 25 km);
`regional` are EURO-CORDEX pairs (12.5 km, Europe only, 27-72 N / 25 W-45 E) usable as `model` ids. A
EURO-CORDEX pair follows the RCP scenarios: its `scenarios` are the SSP ids it accepts (never ssp370) and
`forcing` names the RCP run each one is served from; the file is named and labelled by that RCP. Free.
name: list_cmip6_models
